headline: Jets at Arrowhead, with a 10-point price and a fourth-quarter scar

sectionTitles.currentState: A 5-2 club still patching the late-game picture
sectionTitles.gamePlan: How Kansas City should play the Jets at home
sectionTitles.pressConferences: Week 9 podium notes, attached off the desk

dek: Kansas City hosts the New York Jets on Sun Nov 8, 12:00 PM CT on CBS laying 10 after Denver closed a 24-28 afternoon at Empower Field.
videoHook: The Jets come to Arrowhead with Kansas City laying 10, and the tape that still matters is how a 24-13 lead became 24-28.
theEdge: ESPN FPI lists Kansas City at 80.3 percent to beat the Jets at home, and DraftKings has the Chiefs minus 10 on a 47.5 total — a home favorite that still has to finish the way the 24-13 lead at Denver did not.
editorNotes: Supplied slate record is 5-2; week 8 final is a loss. Do not reconcile on the page.
Scoring table lists DEN TDs at 1, 2, and 5 yards; do not publish an aggregate DEN touchdown count.
Zone-blitz card is a Jets call. Karlaftis forced the Denver fumble; Trautman recovered it.
Last-game window is afternoon. No night wording anywhere.

storyline.lede: The assignment is the New York Jets at GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium, Sun Nov 8, 12:00 PM CT on CBS, with Kansas City a 10-point home favorite. Denver already showed what a one-score road game can do to a 24-13 lead.
body: Patrick Mahomes went 30-of-41 for 321 yards and 3 touchdowns with a 120.1 rating, and the offense posted 22 first downs, 399 yards, and 31:29 of possession. Kenneth Walker III carried 21 times for 69 yards inside a 24-carry, 90-yard team rush. Emmett Johnson caught 5 passes for 128 yards and a touchdown. That is a real afternoon of offense. It still ended 24-28.

Steve Spagnuolo's unit held Denver to 294 yards, 2-of-11 on third down, and 28:31 of possession, with zero turnovers on either side. The fourth quarter did not match that control. Arrowhead Pride's look at the defense's search for a killer instinct starts from the opening of that quarter, Kansas City ahead 24-13. Denver then scored on a 2-yard touchdown at Q4 8:55 and a 5-yard touchdown at Q4 1:56.

Home against the Jets is the reset. ESPN FPI has Kansas City at 80.3 percent. DraftKings has the Chiefs minus 10 with a 47.5 total. That number assumes the 6-of-14 third-down line and the Mahomes accuracy travel, and that the late collapse does not. Andy Reid and Eric Bieniemy still have a short-yardage problem on film: Walker was stopped at the Denver 1, Harrison Butker missed a 54-yard field goal wide right, and the last drive ended on downs.

The roster around that plan is thin on cap room and busy on the practice squad. Arrowhead Pride lists about $1.6 million in space as of Thursday, November 5. Bub Means and Jacob De Jesus are practice-squad adds, not a change to the Sunday skill rotation of Rashee Rice, Travis Kelce, Xavier Worthy, and Johnson.

lastGameReview.label: Week 8 · Sun, Nov 1 · 3:25 PM CT
lastGameReview.lede: At Empower Field, Denver led 3-0 on a 39-yard field goal at Q1 9:43, 5:17 into the game. Kansas City answered with an 11-yard touchdown at Q1 6:04, trailed 7-6 after a 45-yard Denver field goal, then led 14-6 on a 73-yard touchdown at Q2 7:40. A 1-yard Denver touchdown at Q2 1:15 made it 14-13, Harrison Butker's 45-yard field goal at Q2 0:19 made it 17-13, and a 4-yard touchdown at Q3 1:38 made it 24-13. Denver's 2-yard touchdown at Q4 8:55 and 5-yard touchdown at Q4 1:56 finished it 24-28.

analysis.body: The box is not a stalled offense. Kansas City had 22 first downs, 6-of-14 on third down, 90 rushing yards on 24 attempts, 309 net passing yards, 399 total yards, 11 drives, zero turnovers, and 31:29 of possession. Denver had 21 first downs, 2-of-11 on third down, 77 rushing yards on 23 attempts, 217 net passing yards, 294 total yards, 11 drives, zero turnovers, and 28:31. Bo Nix was 20-of-32 with 1 sack and a 103.9 rating. Kansas City recorded 2 quarterback hits. Denver recorded 10 hits on Mahomes, who was sacked twice.

Walker touched the ball 25 times (21 rushes, 4 catches) and was the run identity: right-end gains of 10 and 10 in the second quarter, then a holding flag on Trey Smith that wiped the second of those. Johnson added a 15-yard run up the middle and a 6-touch day, plus the receiving line that won him Pepsi NFL Rookie of the Week. Rice had 7 catches, Kelce 5, Worthy 3. The explosive throws were there. So were the 10 hits.

George Karlaftis had the sack total (1) and forced the fumble on the Nix sack at the Kansas City 46. Adam Trautman recovered for Denver. That is the tape: pressure created a loose ball Denver kept. Jonah Coleman finished with 15 touches and the 5-yard touchdown run up the middle at Q4 1:56. Marvin Mims Jr. had a 14-yard right-end run to the Kansas City 4 on that drive. Courtland Sutton's 23-yard catch and Jaylen Waddle's 35-yard catch were the deep answers Spagnuolo did not erase.

The finish was special teams and the goal line. Butker's 54-yard try at Q4 2:36 was no good, wide right. Walker then ran right end to the Denver 12 and the Denver 1, and up the middle to the 1 for no gain before the turnover on downs at Q4 0:00. Hunter Nourzad's eligible report was the Q4 15:00 snap, a 1-yard Walker carry, not those late snaps. Alex Palczewski reported eligible on the Q2 2:00 Nix run to the 1, among other Denver reports. Flags piled up on Kansas City: Kristian Fulton, Jack Cochrane, Kelce, R Mason Thomas, Fulton again, Trey Smith, Drue Tranquill, Alohi Gilman twice, Jadon Canady, and Jaylon Moore.

takeaways.title: 399 yards, still 24-28
takeaways.body: Mahomes at 30-of-41 and 321 yards with 3 touchdowns was enough to lead 24-13. It was not enough once Denver scored at Q4 8:55 and Q4 1:56.

takeaways.title: Ten hits, two sacks
takeaways.body: Denver hit Mahomes 10 times and sacked him twice. Kansas City hit Nix twice and sacked him once, the Karlaftis play that also forced the fumble Trautman recovered. The pass rush showed up. It did not close the game.

takeaways.title: The 1-yard line and the 54-yard miss
takeaways.body: Walker reached the Denver 1 twice on the last drive and was stopped. Butker missed from 54, wide right, at Q4 2:36. Those two snaps sit next to the 6-of-14 third-down line as the points that did not come.

whatWorked: Mahomes 30-of-41, 321 yards, 3 touchdowns, 120.1 rating, and 309 net passing yards
Johnson's 5 catches for 128 yards and a touchdown, on a 6-touch day
Third-down defense: Denver 2-of-11, 294 total yards, 28:31 possession
Karlaftis's sack and forced fumble, even with Trautman recovering for Denver
whatDidnt: 10 quarterback hits and 2 sacks allowed on Mahomes
Butker's 54-yard miss and the turnover on downs at the Denver 1
A penalty stack that included two flags on Fulton and two on Gilman

currentState.lede: Kansas City is 5-2 and home for the Jets after an offense that moved the ball at Denver and a defense that did not finish a 24-13 lead. The next kickoff is Sun Nov 8, 12:00 PM CT on CBS.

workOn.title: Finish a two-score lead
workOn.body: Arrowhead Pride framed the defense's week around killer instinct after Kansas City converted to open the fourth quarter ahead 24-13. The Jets game plan has to include what happens after the scoreboard looks safe: down, distance, and who is on the field for Coleman-type runs and Sutton-type shots.

workOn.title: Protect Mahomes without emptying the run
workOn.body: Ten hits and two sacks came with Walker at 21 carries and the team at 24 rushes for 90 yards. Bieniemy can keep that carry count and still steal a few dropbacks with screens to Walker and Johnson so the 41-attempt day is not the default.

workOn.title: Short yardage that is not a hope throw
workOn.body: Arrowhead Addict's short-yardage piece lands on the same tape as Walker's no-gain at the Denver 1. Nourzad reported eligible once, at Q4 15:00. If that look is the answer, it has to be called on the snap that needs a yard, not stored for a different series.

thinkAbout.title: Is minus 10 a finish number or a box-score number?
thinkAbout.body: FPI at 80.3 percent and DraftKings at minus 10 describe the Jets matchup, not the Denver finish. Fans should weigh whether 399 yards and 6-of-14 on third down are the identity, or whether 24-28 is the identity until a lead survives the fourth quarter.

thinkAbout.title: How much roster churn is real help?
thinkAbout.body: Means on the practice squad and De Jesus back as a return option, with Nikko Remigio practicing in full on Thursday, are depth notes. They do not change Rice, Kelce, Worthy, or Johnson for Sunday unless the injury sheet says otherwise. Cap space at $1.6 million limits a bigger swing.

gamePlan.lede: Host the Jets, cash a 10-point home number, and treat the fourth quarter as the assignment Denver already graded. Kickoff is Sun Nov 8, 12:00 PM CT at Arrowhead on CBS.
gamePlan.howTheyMatch: Kansas City brings a quarterback at 30-of-41 and 120.1, a back who just handled 25 touches, and a rookie receiver-runner in Johnson who posted 128 yards. The Jets get a defense that can shrink a game — Denver was held to 2-of-11 and 294 yards — and an offense that just gave up 10 hits and the last two touchdowns. Style edge is Kansas City's if the script stays on schedule. Leverage flips if penalties and the 1-yard line travel from Empower Field to Arrowhead.

keys.title: Stay ahead of the sticks with Walker
keys.body: Twenty-one carries for 69 yards was the floor, not a featured day. Early downs to Walker, with Johnson's 15-yard inside run as the changeup, keep Mahomes out of the 10-hit pocket the Broncos found.

keys.title: Use Rice and Kelce before the shot
keys.body: Rice's 7 catches and Kelce's 5 are the layup menu. Worthy and Cyrus Allen can take the verticals once the Jets squeeze the crossers. Do not open with the deep middle incompletion Allen saw against Denver.

keys.title: Rally tackles in a two-deep shell
keys.body: Sutton's 23 and Waddle's 35 were the explosives. Cover 2 takes the top off similar shots and asks the second level — Nick Bolton, Drue Tranquill, Justin Hicks — to tackle the checkdown the way they did not always tackle Coleman (15 touches).

keys.title: Change the picture on obvious passing downs
keys.body: Spagnuolo's zone blitz is the call when the Jets need a third down, the same down Denver converted only twice in 11 tries. Karlaftis, Felix Anudike-Uzomah, and the second-level rushers show heat and drop a lineman. It is a picture change for this week, built off the sack Karlaftis already owns.

script: Open with under-center inside zone to Walker and live with a modest gain if the fit is sound.
On the first second-and-medium, throw mesh to Rice and Kelce with Johnson as the checkdown.
If the Jets rush four and squeeze, screen to Walker behind the 10-hit lesson from Denver.
Once the run is fit, boot Mahomes to the perimeter with Kelce as the flat option.
In the red zone, call the Nourzad eligible look on the down that needs a yard, not a series earlier.
After a score, check to Cover 2 and rally. Do not sit in a single-high look that Sutton and Waddle just stressed.

spotlight.title: Johnson's 128-yard reply
spotlight.body: Arrowhead Pride noted Johnson as Pepsi NFL Rookie of the Week after 5 catches, 128 yards, and a touchdown, with more votes than Jonah Coleman. He also had a 15-yard run. That is a real role against the Jets, not a courtesy snap.

spotlight.title: 24-13 was not the end of the tape
spotlight.body: The Q3 1:38 touchdown made it 24-13. Denver's next two touchdowns, from the 2 and the 5, made it 24-28. Spagnuolo's group is staring at that sequence before it stares at a 10-point spread.

spotlight.title: Remigio full, De Jesus on the squad
spotlight.body: Thursday's injury report had Nikko Remigio practicing in full. Arrowhead Pride and Arrowhead Addict both noted Jacob De Jesus returning to the practice squad as Dave Toub's return insurance. That is the return plan until a Friday sheet says otherwise.

spotlight.title: $1.6 million and a receiver tryout
spotlight.body: Arrowhead Pride's roster file had about $1.6 million in space as of 7:00 p.m. Thursday, November 5. Bub Means, a 2024 Saints draft pick, landed on the practice squad after a tryout. Help is depth, not a splash signing.

spotlight.title: The penalty trend is on the Chiefs tape
spotlight.body: Arrowhead Addict's penalty piece matches a Denver flag list that includes Fulton, Cochrane, Kelce, Thomas, Smith, Tranquill, Gilman, Canady, and Moore. Several wiped plays. That is self-inflicted leverage in a one-score game.

matchups.unit: Mahomes and the dropback game vs. the Jets pass rush
matchups.opponent: Jets pass rush and coverage, unnamed in the wire
matchups.note: 30-of-41, 321 yards, 3 touchdowns, 120.1, and 309 net passing yards is the edge. Ten hits and two sacks are the warning if the Jets tee off the way Denver did.

matchups.unit: Walker and Johnson vs. the Jets run fits
matchups.note: Team rush was 90 yards on 24 attempts, Walker 69 on 21. That is volume without a broken defense. The Jets can crowd this if early downs stall the way the goal-line series did.

matchups.unit: Spagnuolo's third-down defense vs. the Jets offense
matchups.note: Denver was 2-of-11 on third down and gained 294 yards in 28:31. Karlaftis owns the sack. The miss was the fourth quarter, not the down-and-distance defense.

matchups.unit: Kansas City penalty tape vs. field position
matchups.note: Arrowhead Addict's season trend plus the Denver flag list is the opponent edge if it repeats. Wiped plays and personal fouls handed Denver hidden yards in a 4-point game.

matchups.unit: Butker and the short yardage vs. a 47.5 total
matchups.note: A made 45-yard field goal and a missed 54 sit on the same sheet. The last drive died at the 1. Minus 10 needs those points, not another turnover on downs.

xsandos.title: Walker downhill before the Jets squeeze the box
xsandos.situation: Early first and second down at Arrowhead, before Denver's 10-hit pocket becomes the Jets' plan
xsandos.why: The team rushed 24 times for 90 yards and Walker had 21 carries for 69. That identity has to show up before Mahomes is asked to drop back 41 times again. Johnson's 15-yard inside carry is the same family of run, a one-cut answer if the Jets spill Walker.
xsandos.coaching: Bieniemy: zone steps, one cut, no dancing. Walker presses the point of attack and bends only after the linebacker declares. If the fit stacks the interior, hand the next one to Johnson rather than asking Mahomes to scramble into a hit.

xsandos.title: Rice and Kelce on the crossers
xsandos.situation: Second-and-medium after a modest Walker gain, Jets likely in man
xsandos.why: Rice just caught 7 balls and Kelce 5. That is the man-beater menu while Worthy (3 catches) sits outside the rub. Johnson, with 5 receptions, is the outlet if the crossers clog.
xsandos.coaching: Reid and Bieniemy: sell the rub, do not rush the throw. Mahomes hits Rice or Kelce on the break and keeps Johnson as the check if both crossers are squeezed. No need to force Worthy over the top on this down.

xsandos.title: Screen the 10-hit rush
xsandos.situation: Jets show an extra rusher after a sack or a hit, similar to Denver's 10 hits and 2 sacks
xsandos.why: Mahomes was hit 10 times and sacked twice on 41 attempts. A screen to Walker (4 catches) or Johnson steals a down from that rush and uses the same backs who already catch the ball.
xsandos.coaching: Let the line release and lead. Mahomes takes the easy throw, not a hero shot into a collapsing pocket. Walker sets the edge block path; Johnson is the alternate if Walker is the run fake.

xsandos.title: Boot off the Walker sell
xsandos.situation: Play-action call on an early down once Walker has already carried inside zone
xsandos.why: This is the install for the Jets, using Walker's 21-carry volume as the sell. Kelce in the flat and Rice on the intermediate cross give Mahomes a throw away from the interior hits Denver landed.
xsandos.coaching: Under center, sell the run, move the pocket. Mahomes's second read is Kelce on the perimeter, then Rice. If both are covered, throw it away. The point is a clean platform, not another scramble into a hit — he scrambled up the middle for 2 yards and ran left end for 4 in Denver.

xsandos.title: Two-deep after Kansas City scores
xsandos.situation: Jets with the ball after a Kansas City score, similar to Denver trailing 24-13 and still throwing deep
xsandos.why: Sutton caught a 23-yard deep ball and Waddle a 35-yarder. A two-deep, five-under shell takes that shot away and asks Bolton, Tranquill, and Hicks to tackle. Denver still ran Coleman 11 times; the rally has to be real.
xsandos.coaching: Spagnuolo: two deep, no peeking at the run fake. Corners sink, safeties stay on top of anything that looks like Sutton or Waddle. Linebackers fit Coleman-type touches and do not chase the play fake into a vacated hook.

xsandos.title: Zone blitz on the Jets' third down
xsandos.situation: Third-and-medium at Arrowhead, Jets needing a throw
xsandos.why: Denver was 2-of-11 on third down while Karlaftis posted the sack and forced a fumble Trautman recovered. The call this week is simulated pressure: show heat, drop a lineman, rush from the second level, and make the Jets' quarterback throw before a Sutton-length route develops.
xsandos.coaching: Spagnuolo tags it, Karlaftis and Anudike-Uzomah own the rush picture, and a linebacker replaces the dropped lineman in the hook. Tackle after the throw. The win is a changed picture and a third-down stop, the down Denver rarely converted.

coaching.detail: Arrowhead Addict pressed Reid on fourth-and-1 answers. The Denver finish gives him a live rep: Walker to the 1, no gain, turnover on downs, with Nourzad's eligible report on a different snap.
309 net passing yards and 90 rushing yards can coexist.
The third-down defense was sound at 2-of-11 allowed. The fourth-quarter touchdowns from the 2 and the 5 are the install, not a rewrite of the whole call sheet.
De Jesus is back on the practice squad to watch Remigio, who practiced in full on Thursday. Toub's room is insurance, not a featured offensive piece.

injuries.note: Arrowhead Pride's Week 9 Thursday injury report lists Remigio practicing in full ahead of the Jets.

personnel.move: Bub Means to the practice squad
personnel.detail: Arrowhead Pride reported Means, a 2024 fifth-round pick of the Saints, as a practice-squad addition after a tryout. He is depth behind Rice, Worthy, and the current receiving group.

personnel.move: Jacob De Jesus returns to the practice squad
personnel.detail: Chiefs reunited with the rookie returner to monitor the starting returner while Remigio's week is tracked. Listed as a backup return piece, not a skill-position promotion.
Arrowhead Pride's roster file, current as of 7:00 p.m. Thursday, November 5, shows about $1.6 million in space. That frames why the adds are practice-squad moves.

strategies: Lean on Walker early so the Jets cannot tee off the way Denver did for 10 hits and 2 sacks.
Feature Rice and Kelce on mesh before testing Worthy vertically.
Steal a down with a screen to Walker or Johnson whenever the rush declares.
Check to Cover 2 after Kansas City scores so a 24-13 style lead is not a deep-ball invitation.
Call the zone blitz on third-and-medium and rally to the tackle.
Use the Nourzad eligible report on the actual short-yardage snap, and live with Butker inside a range he already made from 45.
debates: Does minus 10 against the Jets overrate a team that just lost 24-28 after leading 24-13?
Should Bieniemy script more than 24 rushes if Mahomes is taking 10 hits?
Is Johnson's Rookie of the Week line a weekly role or a Denver spike?
Does the penalty trend matter more than the 399-yard box when the game is one score?
Is Karlaftis's sack-and-forced-fumble day the pass-rush identity, or does the Trautman recovery show the finish is still missing?
